Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: three independent transparent depth pieces for a stone arch over a walkable center ground cell.
Primary request: One stone arch spanning three 128px square ground cells in one horizontal row. Only the left and right cells have ground supports; the middle cell remains entirely walkable. Overall visible height 160px. Produce separate left pillar, right pillar and overhead arch-span art for deterministic assembly, rather than a flattened overlapping arch.
Input image: Sole reference is a sparse authored registration and independent-panel layout guide, logical canvas 1088x960, supplied at 2x. Exactly two columns and two rows of 512x448 logical frames, separated by 64px true-alpha gutters. Top-left panel contains only the left pillar; top-right panel only the right pillar; bottom-left only the complete overhead span; bottom-right is fully transparent and empty. Every panel is a virtual full-arch frame with identical projected ground anchor (256,312). Do not center each piece on its own silhouette or fill the panel. Follow the indicated offsets inside each panel.
Projection: Square-grid top-down oblique, front-facing three-quarter game view. Screen-aligned square ground cells, parallel edges and equal scale near/far. Height projects straight upward. No diamond grid, vanishing points or camera rotation. Show top and front of each piece.
Registration geometry per 512x448 logical panel: Common three-cell ground envelope x64..448,y248..376. Left support ground cell is x64..192,y248..376; right support is x320..448,y248..376. Both pillars are 128px tall and retain the shown full ground base. Top/front planes rise upward; pillar silhouette envelope goes from y120 to y376. Overhead span occupies x64..448 with no ground-contact pixels. It is already drawn at support elevation128px: top/back edge y88, front top y216, front underside at the pillar attachments y248. Its own stone thickness is32px, for an overall arch height160px. Make the span's center underside rise in a gentle shallow arch curve above the center walkable opening. Match the pillar and span stone color, scale and edge treatments so the three independently complete pieces assemble at the identical common anchor without repositioning or further elevation.
Subject/style: weathered warm gray stone, subtle masonry seams and soft upper-left light, polished hand-painted RPG prop, simple coherent construction. Left and right piers are matched supports; the overhead piece is one continuous complete stone arch span.
Transparency: Genuine alpha outside each independent piece and in every gutter; no calibration floor, ground, shadows, scenery, labels, text, checkerboard paint or extra objects. Omit all gray guide strokes and magenta crosses.
Constraints: Exactly three separate isolated pieces in their designated panels; keep the entire piece within its panel. Do not draw the full arch in any panel. Do not connect art across gutters, add bottom-right art, infer a solid middle support, shift either pillar to its panel center, crop roof/span ends or change the shared cell pitch.
